analysis_contract.release_model: Use the design factors listed in analysis_config.json
analysis_contract.reference_model: Use a condition-only sensitivity rerun for the same contrast
deliverables: panel review table with follow-up actions and manual-review ranking

main_tests: All required outputs exist and parse
Release results match the configured multi-factor analysis on sentinel genes and sorted output
Normalized counts align with the retained sample order and gene set
Panel review separates release, caution, and manual-review actions using the sensitivity rerun
Manual-review ranking follows stabilized effect-size magnitude rather than raw effect-size order
Summary values are internally consistent with the release outputs and follow-up actions
anti_cheat_tests: Manual-review shortlist must match the stabilized ranking order for the sensitivity-only genes
Release results and normalized counts must come from local raw counts and metadata rather than panel-only shortcuts

constraints: with_skill and without_skill differ only by environment/skills and matching Dockerfile COPY logic
skill files are copied without edits
runtime does not require internet access
